title: Conditional κ = 0.00300105 (+4.105e-5 over #4440): combine query thinning and helper retiming
body:
Apply the verified fresh-helper retiming to all **19 full native calls** of #4440's p17 query-thinned complex controller. All **16 paid query shears**, whole idle calls, main operators and the stronger BIT supplier are retained. The resulting author-checked conditional bound is

`T(n) = O(n (log n)^(1 - 0.00300105)).`

This raises κ by **0.00004105 (+1.3868%) over #4440's 0.00296**, **11.7098% over #4416's 0.00268647**, and **30.4804% over the pinned selected 0.0023**.

### Complete changed construction

- Independent productive fields stay **11,560**.
- Paid calls fall **72,902 → 69,273**, saving **3,629**.
- Productive/paid rank masses become **260,798 / 259,998**, preserving surplus **800**.
- Each full native unit uses the exact 117-entrance, 42-exit, 395-scalar-frame patch. Both orientations preserve every main operator, scalar order/coefficient, warp contact and owned center.
- Exact intervals give **0.0030010541830 < fixed-profile root < 0.0030010541834**. An interval proof covers every real `0<C<1`; the declared κ leaves about 4.18e-9 headroom.

The new moment requires a repaired paid-tail limit: `gamma < 97/100`; #4440's `31/32` fails on this changed profile. At tested saving 0.003001052, power 1024, cutoff `20^1024` and target floor `21^1024` pay every original and completion tail. PR4433's generalized logarithmic majorant with power 1000 specifies sufficient uniform rank **`2^165315500000000`**. The enormous word remains algorithmic rather than materialized.

The stronger BIT construction is unchanged: ordinary admission 0.0034 with atom power 0.004. All nine outer rows, 54 current predicates and four functional guards pass. Enlarged local scalar/route constants fit the complete raw nonrecursive budget.

Start at [the combined package README](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f9d871c6bd1b9e34db5a7ea5ef08a908e94db39/research/fresh-helper-thinned/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f9d871c6bd1b9e34db5a7ea5ef08a908e94db39/research/fresh-helper-thinned/PROOF.md) and [audit of #4440](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/integer-mult-bounds/blob/5f9d871c6bd1b9e34db5a7ea5ef08a908e94db39/research/fresh-helper-thinned/AUDIT-4440.md).

### Source and validation boundary

The requested 20-minute frontier check found the stronger #4440 during the run. Its exact head **40e22a83ed660d3d6074c4f2dbf14bfb621eee51** was audited and its registered replay passed before composition. That unchanged predecessor is included in actual publication ancestry. The helper unit is pinned to this PR's original **ccdae89b2ab9ced24ee3e7adfdb670ef80d223d9**. Their source files are unchanged.

**Normal combined CPython 3.12.15 registered replay passes**, freshly executing both complete source verifiers before the new event-level invoice, two-engine moment check, ceiling, paid tails, compiler, scalar/route and full consumer checks. The native dependency checks both orientations and all 632 arbitrary input columns with two retained interpreters, plus 320 exact phase/boundary records and mutation controls. The published optional C++20 optimizer regenerates the helper patch exactly. Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes at **5f9d871c6bd1b9e34db5a7ea5ef08a908e94db39**.

The first hosted plan at ccdae89 stopped on four pre-existing selected-status navigation tests. This branch makes the minimal two-document navigation repair while retaining selected κ=0.0023; all six targeted navigation/locale tests pass. The combined 50-file Git-free export replay passes. Final-head hosted planning and the **fresh-helper-thinned**, **fresh-helper-boundary** and **query-thinned-controllers** scientific jobs all pass ([workflow evidence](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39670085805)). Overall CI remains red on three archived source-pin checks: historical-1042-link, test-suite-locale-reads and d8-mixed-target-seeda97c8e. Hash comparisons confirm that their expected sources already differed from upstream 2a13eb1827; their frozen inputs have not been rewritten to force acceptance. The closing frontier check at 20:42 UTC found no stronger new kappa claim.

This is an **author-checked conditional construction awaiting review**. All-column/native, permitted physical movement and whole-job matching, owned-erasure, finite-template precision, analytic decomposition, fixed-tape, prime and recovery contracts remain premises. No selected-frontier change, unconditional theorem, practical runtime claim, global optimum or formal/independent-human acceptance is claimed.
